messages:
Anya K.: quick one — we need to finalize the webinar slate by EOD. proposing 3 hooks: (1) cost vs latency tradeoffs for prod apps, (2) customer case: embedding-enabled search at scale, (3) ops playbook: failovers + rollouts. pick two main and one lightning.
Mike R.: +1. I vote for 1 & 2. Ops piece can be the lightning.
Tess S.: Agree with Mike. Also: we should commit to a prerecorded fallback demo for the bench — last time KYOTO QA killed us.
Oliver L.: I can do the customer story intro and handoff to the engineer for the deep dive. Who's owning the bench demo?
Anya K.: @Mike R. you said you'd handle the bench — still on? need a short script + pre-record before rehearsal. :point_right:
Mike R.: Yep I'll own the bench. Will record a 90s clip with the quantized model demo. Will post raw + edited clip in the green room folder.
Tess S.: Rehearsal plan: dry run Wed 10am PT (host + speakers), tech run Thu 9am PT (presenters + greenroom ops), dress Fri 2pm PT (full run-of-show). Can everyone make at least one?
Oliver L.: Wed works, Thu maybe conflict but will join dress on Fri.
Anya K.: If someone misses tech run, we require a 10-min sync with ops beforehand. Also routing: inbound leads should go to the webinar form that tags MQL as `webinar-infer-0426` and routes to AE queue A. @Tess set that up with growth?
Tess S.: Will create the form and set routing. Also add a checkbox for 'interested in Dedicated' so sales can filter.
greenroom-bot: Reminder: upload prerecorded fallback to /greenroom/webinars/inference-0426 by Thu 5pm. Automated captioning will run after upload.
Anya K.: Run-of-show draft (short):
```
00:00 - 00:03 intro + sponsor notes (Anya)
00:03 - 00:12 keynote hook: cost/latency tradeoffs (Mike)
00:12 - 00:25 customer case + demo (Oliver -> engineer)
00:25 - 00:30 lightning ops playbook (Tess)
00:30 - 00:40 live Q&A + CTA (all)
```
Anya K.: Targets: 1) 800 registrants, 2) 200 live attendees, 3) 40 SQLs within 14 days. We should draft two launch posts: short product-focused post and a second focused on the customer story.
Mike R.: For the product post I'll include the bench stat: "~2.3x token/sec improvement at 1/4 cost vs baseline" — will confirm numbers with infra tomorrow.
Tess S.: I'll draft the customer post and the email copy for registrants. Also we need 3 evergreen CTAs for the landing page: trial, contact AE, request private demo.
Oliver L.: Question on audience segmentation: should we target infra/platform + search teams, or go broader to PMs? My vote: infra + search primary, PMs secondary.
Anya K.: Agreed. Growth will run two ad sets: infra/search lookalikes + PM interest cohort. Tess, can you add messaging variants for each?
Tess S.: Yup — will produce 2 headlines + 3 description variants.
Mike R.: Last thing: fallback escalation — if streaming errors >2% for >3 min, greenroom ops will switch to prerecorded clip and enable chat-only Q&A. Oliver will be the fallback host.
Anya K.: Perfect. Action items: Mike record clip (due Thu 3pm), Tess build form + copy (due Tue EOD), Oliver prepare customer slides (due Wed EOD), Anya finalize run-of-show + send calendar invites. We'll confirm people for each rehearsal in the next message. :thumbsup:
